entities.name: Santa Maria del Parto a Mergellina, Naples
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Santa Maria del Parto a Mergellina is a church located in the quartiere of Chiaia in Naples, Italy. The church is peculiarly perched on top of a private building and accessed by a stairway, placed behind a restaurant located in piazza Mergellina.
